deficiencies.description: The rewrite conflates two distinct functions mentioned by the lecturer—providing 'signaling' and providing a 'basis for their adherence'—into a single concept: 'a signalling basis'. In cell biology, the extracellular matrix provides biochemical signaling as well as a physical/structural basis (substrate) for cell adhesion.
